newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India issues tender to import diesel for August.
newsitem.headline: India issues tender to import diesel for August.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a tender to buy high speed diesel for deliveries in August, traders said on Thursday.
The tender seeks 0.5 and 1.0 percent sulphur diesel for deliveries to Madras or Haldia on the Indian east coast and to Kandla on the west coast. Each cargo comprises 40,000-45,000 tonnes.
The tender closes on July 3 and offers will be valid until July 4.

IOC bought a total of 855,000 tonnes of diesel in 19 cargoes in its tender for July deliveries. It took 12 cargoes of 1.0-percent sulphur diesel, five cargoes of 0.5-percent sulphur, and two cargoes of 0.25 percent sulphur diesel.
